To write to files you use the [b]write [/b]method.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="354"]file = open("newfile.txt", "w")
file.[b]write[/b]("This has been written to a file")
file.close()[/code]

[note]In case the file already exists, its entire content will be replaced when you open it in write mode using "w".[/note]

resolved.title: 写文件
resolved.problem_statement_md:
输入数字**N**，将数字1到N写到文件 "**numbers.txt**"中，每个数字单独成行。

给定的代码会自动读取文件的内容并输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Writing Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Take a number [b]N[/b] as input and write the numbers 1 to N to the file "[b]numbers.txt[/b]", each number on a separate line.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
4

[b]Sample Output[/b]
1
2
3
4

The given code reads the content of the file and outputs it.
[note]You can use [b]\n[/b] to make line breaks.
Do not forget to [b]close[/b] the file after writing to it.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 使用`\n`进行换行。
- 写完后不要忘记**close**的文件。

code_templates.template:
n = int(input())

file = open("numbers.txt", "w+")
#完善代码，写文件


# 以下代码勿改
f = open("numbers.txt", "r")
print(f.read())
f.close()
code_templates.solution_code:
n = int(input()) 
 
file = open("numbers.txt", "w+") 
 
for i in range(1,n+1):
    file.write(str(i)+"\n") 

file.close()
 
f = open("numbers.txt", "r") 
print(f.read()) 
f.close()
